bibliographic.title: Pegasus
bibliographic.author: Joshua Mandell
bibliographic.description: You awaken in total darkness. For a brief moment you are in a state of panic, and then your eyes snap open. All that you can see is green, and the occasional bubble. Yet that is about to change. The liquid that you seem to be drifting in is draining, the volume of it reducing slowly until it drains into the bottom of the small container in which you seem to have been housed. You don't know why you are here, or even who you are -- but you are awake now. The glass, which now has come into view to reveal a roomful of similar cells, some empty, some with people floating inside of them, shatters, and you stumble to the cold floor.
